name: Roster
description: A complete team-planning product with editable weekly allocations, daily capacity, time off, overbooking and project-hour views.
tagline: A plan that leaves room for people.

notes.layout: Navy split hero, readable schedule vignette, weekly person and day workspace, project-hour views and a working guide
notes.motion: Schedule entrance, linked allocation hover, perspective switches and accessible dialogs
notes.interaction: Edit allocations and time off, find overbooking, reassign project hours, compare estimates, save notes and export CSV
notes.provenance: Five original pages with a shared, tested planning model, original fictional teams and working local staffing flows.
